about.automod_body:
When enabled, creates/updates a dedicated AntiBeast AutoMod rule that blocks everyone/here and every non-bypassed role mention.
It also temporarily grants @everyone the permission to mention everyone/here/all roles; disabling restores the original setting.
about.bypass_body: Roles that need to stay normally mentionable can be added to the bypass list; those roles are left out of the AutoMod keyword filter.
about.desc:
As everyone knows, Discord is full of Mr. Beast image scams these days.
AntiBeast uses native Discord AutoMod to block everyone/here and role mentions, while letting scam bots believe the server allows mass mentions.
about.trigger_action_body: You can configure a Moderate action to run after AntiBeast is triggered a set number of times within a set window; the default is a kick.

block_message: AntiBeast blocked an everyone/here or protected-role mention.

setup.action_desc:
Configure the Moderate command to run after one user triggers AntiBeast repeatedly in a short window.
By default they're kicked once the threshold is reached.

setup.bypass_desc:
Pick the roles that need to stay normally mentionable.
Selected roles are left out of AntiBeast's AutoMod keyword filter.
setup.confirm_desc: Review the settings and hit enable; AntiBeast will create/update the AutoMod rule and apply the @everyone permission.
